noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

urlOrEncodedPathPrefix.description:
Path prefix on which notifications should be generated. E.g. "data" in the default bucket on this environment or
the fully qualified s3 url.

eventType.description:
Comma separated list of values. E.g. s3:ObjectCreated:*, s3:ObjectCreated:Put. Here's the full list
http://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/dev/NotificationHowTo.html#supported-notification-event-types

autoRegister.description:
Enables automatic registration of s3Event by type listener
@see TypeListener
